item.title: Seven 'Seed Technologies' Selected as Next Growth Engine in the AI Era (AI시대 다음 먹거리 ‘7대 씨앗 기술’ 선정)
item.description:
Seven 'Seed Technologies' Selected as Next Growth Engine in the AI Era (AI시대 다음 먹거리 ‘7대 씨앗 기술’ 선정)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 12th, "We must seize the golden opportunity created by the semiconductor industry and prepare in advance for the next growth engine beyond the artificial intelligence (AI) era," announcing plans to foster seven cutting-edge technologies—small modular reactors (SMRs), nuclear fusion, renewable energy, quantum, space and aviation, advanced biotechnology, and core mineral, material, component, and equipment supply chains—as key future growth drivers. (이재명 대통령은 12일 “반도체 산업이 만들어 준 절호의 기회를 활용해 인공지능(AI) 시대, 그 다음 먹거리를 미리 준비해야 한다”며 소형 모듈 원자로(SMR)와 핵융합, 재생에너지, 양자, 우주·항공, 첨단 바이오, 핵심 광물·소재·부품·장비 공급망 등 7개 첨단 기술을 미래 성장 동력으로 집중 육성하겠다고 밝혔다.)

At the "Future Growth Engines: Seven SEED (Strategic Emerging Engines for Disruptive innovation) Briefing" held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, President Lee stated, "Whether we become leaders enjoying limitless opportunities or laggards perpetually exposed to the risk of obsolescence depends on our choices." Cheong Wa Dae explained, "We named it SEED to signify 'seed industries' that require strategic investment." The president added, "I believe that the cutting-edge technology seeds we plant today will grow into towering trees and evolve into new mega projects in the future." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 ‘미래 성장 동력, 7대 SEED(시드·Strategic Emerging Engines for Disruptive innovation) 보고회’에서 “우리가 무한한 기회를 누리는 선도자가 될 것인지, 도태의 위험에 언제나 노출돼 있는 추격자가 될 것인지는 우리의 선택에 달려 있다”면서 이같이 말했다. 청와대는 “전략적 투자가 필요한 ‘씨앗 산업’이라는 의미에서 SEED라 명명했다”고 설명했다. 이 대통령은 “오늘 우리가 뿌린 첨단 기술 씨앗들이 미래에는 거대한 나무로 자라나서 새로운 메가 프로젝트로 자라나게 될 것으로 믿는다”고 했다.)

The briefing also presented targets such as landing on the Moon by 2030, achieving the world's No. 1 quantum chip manufacturing capability by 2035, and generating power through nuclear fusion in the 2030s. It also outlined plans to avoid repeating past failures where technologies were developed but commercialization and market creation fell through, by establishing public-private joint special purpose companies (SPCs) in sectors requiring large initial investments to pursue technology development and commercialization together. < (이날 보고회에서는 2030년 달 착륙, 2035년 양자칩 제조 역량 세계 1위, 2030년대 핵융합 전력 생산 같은 목표도 제시됐다. 기술 개발에 성공하고서도 사업화와 시장 창출에 실패했던 과거 사례를 반복하지 않도록 초기 투자 부담이 큰 분야에 민관 공동 출자 특수목적법인(SPC)을 세워 기술 개발과 상용화를 함께 추진한다는 방침도 밝혔다.)

item.title: 41 Countries Including South Korea, US, Japan Say "Pacific Missile Test Undermines Security of Neighboring Countries" (한·미·일 등 41국 “태평양 미사일 시험, 인접국가 안보 저해”)
item.description:
41 Countries Including South Korea, US, Japan Say "Pacific Missile Test Undermines Security of Neighboring Countries" (한·미·일 등 41국 “태평양 미사일 시험, 인접국가 안보 저해”)

Forty-one countries, including South Korea, the United States, Japan, and major European nations, issued a critical statement on the 11th (local time) regarding China's recent submarine-launched ballistic missile (SLBM) test launch. The Chinese People's Liberation Army launched an SLBM with a range of over 10,000 km from a nuclear submarine in waters near China toward the South Pacific on the 6th of last month, carrying a mock warhead for training purposes. To prevent other countries from gathering intelligence, they notified Australia, New Zealand, and other nations near the impact zone of the launch plan only a few hours before the launch, sparking significant backlash. <<> In response, the U.S. State Department issued a "Joint Statement on Ballistic Missile Launch Notifications" on behalf of 41 governments on the 11th, urging "all states that launch intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs), SLBMs, or space launch vehicles (SLVs), particularly nuclear-armed states, to provide notification of such launches at least 24 hours in advance." While not directly naming "China," the statement included language noting that "recent missile test activity in the Pacific region has not followed the standard practices adopted by most nations," which is interpreted as a pointed reference to the Chinese People's Liberation Army's SLBM launch. <<> The 41 countries stated, "Conducting tests of ballistic missiles with nuclear-capable capabilities without sufficient prior notification and detailed information is dangerous and undermines the peace and security of affected states adjacent to such tests," adding, "This increases the risk of miscalculation, undermines global stability and security, and is incompatible with the responsibilities that come with possessing long-range missile capabilities." They also said, "We will continue to work to hold accountable those states whose actions fall short of responsibility." <<> The specific specifications of the SLBM launched by China last month were not disclosed. At the time, Chinese media reported that the People's Liberation Army had tested the 'JL-3' (Julang-3) missile, which has the entire U.S. within its range, and the United States, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand immediately voiced opposition. <<> South Korea had refrained from publicly condemning China at the time but joined this joint statement. In response, South Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that the statement was issued under U.S. leadership, saying, "As we have consistently emphasized the importance of strengthening the pre-notification system for ballistic missiles and space launch vehicles, we joined the joint statement based on our principled position." (한국·미국·일본과 유럽 주요국 등 41국이 11일(현지 시각) 최근 중국의 잠수함발사탄도미사일(SLBM) 시험 발사를 겨냥한 비판 성명을 냈다. 중국 인민해방군은 지난달 6일 중국 인근 해역의 핵잠수함에서 남태평양으로 훈련용 모의 탄두를 탑재한 사거리 1만km 이상의 SLBM을 발사했는데, 타국의 정보 수집을 막기 위해 호주·뉴질랜드 등 낙하 지점 인근 국가에 발사 몇 시간 전에야 발사 계획을 통보해 큰 반발을 샀다.)

item.title: North Korea provokes with ballistic missile again after six days... flew over 700 km (北, 엿새만에 또 탄도미사일 도발… 700㎞ 이상 날아갔다)
item.description:
North Korea provokes with ballistic missile again after six days... flew over 700 km (北, 엿새만에 또 탄도미사일 도발… 700㎞ 이상 날아갔다)

North Korea launched a ballistic missile into the East Sea on the 12th. This is another provocation just six days after it fired a short-range ballistic missile into the East Sea on the 6th. The National Security Office held an "emergency security situation review meeting" attended by relevant agencies such as the Ministry of National Defense and the Joint Chiefs of Staff on the same day, urging North Korea to halt its ballistic missile launches, calling them "violations of UN Security Council resolutions." (북한이 12일 동해상으로 탄도미사일을 발사했다. 지난 6일 단거리 탄도미사일을 동해로 발사한 지 엿새 만에 다시 도발에 나선 것이다. 국가안보실은 이날 국방부와 합참 등 관계기관이 참석한 가운데 ‘긴급 안보상황 점검회의’를 열어 북한의 탄도미사일 발사는 “유엔 안보리 결의 위반”이라며 중단을 촉구했다.)

The Joint Chiefs of Staff said it detected one ballistic missile launched from the Wonsan area toward the East Sea at around 6 a.m. that day. The JCS stated, "The detected North Korean missile flew more than 700 km, and the ROK-U.S. alliance is conducting a detailed analysis of the exact specifications." Although the maximum range of North Korea's short-range ballistic missile KN-23 (North Korea's version of the Iskander) is around 700–800 km, the JCS did not specify it as a "short-range ballistic missile." There is a possibility that North Korea reduced the range of a medium-range ballistic missile for launch, or test-fired a short-range hypersonic missile. (합동참모본부는 이날 오전 6시쯤 북한 원산 일대에서 동해상으로 발사된 탄도미사일 1발을 포착했다고 밝혔다. 합참은 “포착된 북한의 미사일은 700㎞ 이상 비행했으며, 정확한 제원에 대해서는 한미가 정밀 분석 중”이라고 했다. 북한 단거리 탄도미사일 KN-23(북한판 이스칸데르)의 최대 사거리가 700~800㎞ 안팎이지만, 합참은 ‘단거리 탄도미사일’이라고 명시하지 않았다. 북한이 준중거리 탄도미사일의 사거리를 줄여 발사하거나, 단거리 극초음속 미사일을 시험발사했을 가능성도 있다.)

According to Japan's Ministry of Defense, the ballistic missile launched by North Korea that day reached an apogee of 90 km. This is higher than the known apogee of 50–60 km for the existing KN-23, raising the possibility of a test of a hypersonic glide vehicle warhead at high altitude. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said, "There is a possibility that a test was conducted combining a hypersonic glide vehicle warhead with the body of the short-range ballistic missile KN-23." (일본 방위성에 따르면 이날 북한이 발사한 탄도미사일의 정점 고도는 90㎞였다. 기존 KN-23의 정점 고도로 알려진 50~60㎞보다 더 높아, 고고도에서 극초음속 활공체 탄두 시험을 했을 가능성도 제기된다. 홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “단거리 탄도미사일 KN-23 동체에 극초음속 활공체 탄두를 결합한 시험을 했을 가능성이 있다”고 했다.)

Yoo Ji-hoon, a research fellow at the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses (KIDA), said, "This launch could be a reliability verification of missiles supplied to Russia, or a performance improvement test reflecting problems identified on the Ukrainian battlefield." According to foreign media, Ukrainian intelligence authorities believe that North Korea has deployed a missile unit of around 90 personnel operating KN-23 series missiles to the front lines against Ukraine this month. (유지훈 한국국방연구원(KIDA) 연구위원은 “(이번 발사가) 러시아에 공급되는 미사일의 신뢰성 검증이나, 우크라이나 전장에서 확인된 문제점을 반영한 성능 개량 시험일 가능성이 있다”고 했다. 외신에 따르면 우크라이나 정보당국은 북한이 이달 들어 KN-23 계열 미사일을 운용할 90여 명 안팎의 미사일 부대를 대(對)우크라이나 전선에 배치하고 있다고 판단하고 있다.)

North Korea's latest provocation comes ahead of the ROK-U.S. joint exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield" (UFS), which begins on the 17th. North Korea has historically reacted sensitively to the ROK-U.S. UFS exercises, calling them "rehearsals for invasion of the North." On the same day, North Korea also issued a statement in the name of First Vice Foreign Minister Kim Jong-gum claiming that the South Korean government's plan to introduce nuclear-powered submarines is "a serious challenge to (North Korea's) security and maritime sovereignty." (북한의 이번 도발은 오는 17일부터 시작되는 한미 연합연습 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)를 앞두고 이뤄졌다. 그간 북한은 한미의 UFS 연습이 ‘북침 연습’이라며 예민한 반응을 보여왔다. 북한은 이날 장금철 외무성 제1부상 명의로 우리 정부의 원자력 추진 잠수함 도입 계획이 “(북한의) 안전과 해상 주권에 대한 엄중한 도전”이란 담화도 냈다.)

item.title: Heads of Three Service Academies' Alumni Associations Tell Ahn Kyu-baek "Opposition to Hasty Merger of Service Academies" (3사 총동창회장들, 안규백에 “사관학교 졸속 통합 반대”)
item.description:
Heads of Three Service Academies' Alumni Associations Tell Ahn Kyu-baek "Opposition to Hasty Merger of Service Academies" (3사 총동창회장들, 안규백에 “사관학교 졸속 통합 반대”)

The alumni association presidents of the three service academies—Army, Navy, and Air Force—visited the Ministry of National Defense building in Yongsan, Seoul, on the 12th to convey their position to Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek that they "oppose the hasty merger of the service academies." The alumni associations of the Korea Military Academy (KMA), Korea Naval Academy (KNA), and Korea Air Force Academy (KAFA) began collective action last month on the 8th with a "National Rally Against the Merger of Service Academies" in front of the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, but this is the first time the alumni association presidents have met directly with the defense minister to state their opposition. <<> Park Pan-jun, president of the KMA Alumni Association (retired colonel), Lee Beom-rim, president of the KNA Alumni Association (retired lieutenant general), and Hwang Seong-jin, president of the KAFA Alumni Association (retired lieutenant general), met with Minister Ahn for about an hour that afternoon in the reception room of the defense ministry building. Park appeared at the meeting wearing a black suit and black tie. Park said, "Since the KMA is being shut down, we are in mourning. Until this issue is resolved, we have decided to keep wearing mourning attire and carry out all official activities in that state." <<> At the meeting, the alumni association presidents are said to have primarily conveyed concerns from both within and outside the military that the merger of the service academies is being pushed forward unilaterally without sufficient consensus among active-duty and reserve military personnel and the general public. The atmosphere was reportedly one in which the alumni association presidents did most of the speaking while Minister Ahn listened and took notes. <<> At that gathering, Park Pan-jun, president of the KMA Alumni Association, is said to have brought up President Lee Jae-myung's remarks during the defense ministry's work report on the 5th, when he ordered the swift integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies and stated, "The Korea Military Academy has been at the center of military coups three times in this country, yet no one has ever been held accountable." After the meeting, Park told reporters, "He said they weren't punished for the coups, but they all were punished. President Chun Doo-hwan couldn't even be buried in the national cemetery, and all those involved had their decorations stripped and were punished." He added, "How many juniors have suffered because of the (December 3) martial law and even had to give up their military careers?" <<> Park said, "Even if the KMA staged coups, what fault do the current cadets have?" and "If they say they're pushing this (merger) because of the martial law forces, then I told them I'd apologize to the president on behalf of the KMA Alumni Association president and asked them to arrange a meeting." If he were to meet President Lee, he said he would tell him, "Merging the service academies makes no sense, so please back off." <<> At the meeting, Lee Beom-rim, president of the KNA Alumni Association, is said to have stated, "With the liberation in 1945, the Navy was established first among the services, so the Naval Academy has a long history. There's no reason we should face punitive closure without any justification, is there?" He also reportedly said, "No matter which country's naval academy you visit in the world, not a single one is located away from the sea." The defense ministry announced last month a basic plan to establish a "National Defense University" at the inland site of Jaundae in Daejeon. <<> Hwang Seong-jin, president of the KAFA Alumni Association, is said to have remarked, "(Securing talent) isn't solved by merging the service academies; it's solved by improving treatment." He added, "Rather than a short-term physical merger, we could create a virtual campus suited to the era of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, where cadets can discuss with each other and receive education together." <<> As soon as the meeting, which lasted just over an hour, ended, the alumni association presidents and the defense ministry began to diverge in their accounts. After the meeting, the alumni association presidents said, "The minister promised to consider, as one option, a plan to pursue education reform while maintaining the current system of service academies." In other words, Minister Ahn had said he would also review maintaining the status quo. <<> However, the defense ministry stated, "It is not true that he said he would review maintaining the current system." Minister Ahn reportedly only said he would "listen to various opinions with an open mind." The defense ministry said, "While proceeding on the basis of establishing the National Defense University, we will achieve the best service academy education reform by reflecting the various opinions raised." <<> An official from the alumni association side who attended the meeting said, "Throughout the meeting, it was hard to shake the doubt about whether Minister Ahn himself truly has a serious understanding or sufficient knowledge to push forward such a momentous matter." Feeling that Minister Ahn did not have the authority, they said they requested, "Please arrange a meeting with President Lee." In response, the presidential office said no meeting has been scheduled yet. (육·해·공군 3군 사관학교 총동창회장들이 12일 서울 용산 국방부 청사를 찾아가 안규백 국방부 장관에게 “사관학교 졸속 통합을 반대한다”는 입장을 전했다. 육·해·공사 총동창회는 지난달 8일 서울 여의도 국회 본관 앞에서 ‘사관학교 통폐합 반대 국민 총궐기 대회’를 열며 집단행동을 시작했지만, 총동창회장들이 국방부 장관을 직접 만나 ‘반대 의사’를 밝힌 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

item.title: President Lee's First Greeting with U.S. Ambassador Steel (李대통령, 스틸 美대사와 첫 인사)
item.description:
President Lee's First Greeting with U.S. Ambassador Steel (李대통령, 스틸 美대사와 첫 인사 )

President Lee Jae-myung posed for a commemorative photo with U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel (left) and her spouse, attorney Sean Steel (right), at the credential presentation ceremony for foreign ambassadors to South Korea held at the Blue House on the 12th. During the conversation following the ceremony, Ambassador Steel said to the Korean-English interpreter seated by the Blue House, "I speak Korean, so you can speak in Korean," to which President Lee responded, "But your husband is here — would that be okay?" When President Lee remarked, "You speak Korean so well, the interpreter must be nervous," Ambassador Steel continued the light-hearted exchange by telling the interpreter, "Don't be nervous," according to the Blue House. (이재명 대통령이 12일 청와대에서 열린 주한 외국 대사 신임장 제정식에서 미셸 스틸(왼쪽) 주한 미국 대사, 배우자 숀 스틸(오른쪽) 변호사와 기념 촬영을 하고 있다. 제정식 후 환담에서 스틸 대사는 청와대 측이 배석시킨 한·영 통역을 향해 “제가 한국말을 하니 한국말로 하셔도 된다”고 했고, 이 대통령은 “남편분도 계신데 그러면 되겠냐”고 했다. 이 대통령이 “한국말도 잘하셔서 (통역이) 긴장되겠다”고 하자, 스틸 대사는 통역에게 “긴장하지 마세요”라며 담소를 이어갔다고 청와대는 전했다.)

item.title: Over a presidential approval rating lower than the party's… Song, Chung, and Kim clash (與보다 낮아진 대통령 지지율 놓고… 치고받은 宋·鄭·金)
item.description:
Over a presidential approval rating lower than the party's… Song, Chung, and Kim clash (與보다 낮아진 대통령 지지율 놓고… 치고받은 宋·鄭·金)

President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs approval rating has fallen, and in some surveys it has dipped below the approval rating of the Democratic Party of Korea, making the president's approval rating a hot topic in the party's national convention. All party leader candidates promised to restore the president's approval rating, but their diagnoses differed. Candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil cited real estate and stock market issues and discord between the party and the government as causes, while candidate Chung Cheong-rae, the immediate former party leader, pointed to the departure of hardcore supporters due to a decline in reformism. A political source said, "At a time when the Lee Jae-myung administration has just entered its second year in office, it is itself unprecedented for ruling party leadership contenders to publicly raise the issue of the president's falling approval rating." (이재명 대통령 국정 지지율이 하락하고 일부 조사에서 더불어민주당 지지율보다 낮아지면서 대통령 지지율이 민주당 전당대회 화두로 떠올랐다. 당대표 후보들이 일제히 대통령 지지율을 회복시키겠다고 약속했지만 진단은 달랐다. 김민석·송영길 후보는 부동산·주식시장 문제와 당정(黨政) 불협화음을 원인으로 꼽은 반면, 직전 당대표였던 정청래 후보는 개혁성 퇴조로 인한 강성 지지층 이탈을 원인으로 꼽았다. 정치권 관계자는 “이재명 정부가 집권 2년 차에 막 들어선 상황에서 여당 당권 주자들이 공개적으로 대통령 지지율 하락 문제를 꺼낸 것 자체가 이례적인 상황”이라고 했다.)

In a wireless automated response (ARS) poll released on the 12th by polling firm JoWon C&I, the president's approval rating fell 4.5 percentage points (p) from two weeks earlier to 42.9%, while the Democratic Party's approval rating rose 0.1p to 46.4%. In an ARS poll released by Realmeter on the 10th, the president's approval rating was also 43.3%, the lowest since taking office, and below the Democratic Party's approval rating (44.6%). In wireless phone interview surveys conducted by Gallup Korea and the four polling firms (Embrain Public, K-STAT Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research), the president's approval rating recorded the low 50s, ahead of the Democratic Party. However, unlike the president's approval rating, which showed a decline in July, the Democratic Party's approval rating rebounded slightly during the same period, showing a tendency toward decoupling between the president's and the ruling party's approval ratings (for details on each poll, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (여론조사 업체 조원씨앤아이가 12일 발표한 무선전화 자동응답(ARS) 조사에서 이 대통령 지지율은 2주 전보다 4.5%포인트(p) 떨어진 42.9%, 민주당 지지율은 0.1%p 오른 46.4%였다. 리얼미터가 지난 10일 발표한 ARS 조사에서도 이 대통령 지지율은 43.3%로 취임 후 최저였고, 민주당 지지율(44.6%)을 밑돌았다. 한국갤럽이나 여론조사 4사(엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치)가 실시하는 무선 전화 면접 조사에서는 이 대통령 지지율이 50%대 초반을 기록하며 민주당을 앞서고 있다. 다만 7월 하락세를 보인 이 대통령 지지율과 달리 민주당 지지율은 같은 기간 소폭 반등하는 등 대통령과 여당 지지율이 탈동조화하는 경향도 나타났다(각 여론조사의 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조).)

Candidate Chung Cheong-rae appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel on the 11th and said of the falling presidential approval rating, "It seems the core support base has turned its back," adding, "The moment Chung Cheong-rae becomes party leader, the president's approval rating will rise by more than 10 percentage points." On the 12th, he held a press conference at the National Assembly and said, "To raise the president's approval rating now, we need a reformist leadership—Chung Cheong-rae," and "With the power of party members, I will rebuild the reformist identity and restore the president's approval rating to over 60%." (정청래 후보는 지난 11일 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 대통령 지지율 하락에 대해 “핵심 지지층이 등을 돌린 것 같다”며 “정청래가 당대표가 되는 즉시 대통령 지지율이 10%p 이상 올라갈 것”이라고 했다. 12일에는 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “지금 대통령 지지율을 끌어올리려면 개혁 지도부, 정청래가 필요하다”며 “당원들의 힘으로 개혁 정체성을 재건하고, 대통령 지지율을 60% 이상으로 회복하겠다”고 했다.)

In response, candidate Song Young-gil on the 12th on KBS Radio called Chung's analysis a "quack diagnosis." Song said, "It's the middle class that has drifted away, causing the rating to drop—how is it that the core support base turned its back?" adding, "The core of the decline is that real estate was mishandled and stock prices fell due to the impact of single-stock leveraged ETFs (exchange-traded funds)." He also said, "We must not touch real estate taxes." (그러자 송영길 후보는 12일 KBS라디오에서 정 후보의 분석을 “돌팔이 진단”이라고 했다. 송 후보는 “지금 중간층이 떨어져 나가서 (지지율이) 내려갔지, 무슨 핵심 지지층이 등을 돌려서 내려갔느냐”며 “지지율 하락의 핵심은 부동산을 잘못 다뤘고 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF(상장지수펀드) 영향으로 주가가 떨어졌기 때문”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “부동산 세금에 손대지 말아야 한다”고 했다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok also appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel the same day and diagnosed the falling approval rating, saying, "There was a loosening of the middle class, and amid the fierce infighting within the party over the national convention, supporters stepped back, wondering 'why are they fighting internally.'" Kim said, "Conservative momentum rose (after the June 3 local elections), and leveraged ETF and real estate issues also emerged at the same time," adding, "If I am elected, the discord between the party and government will disappear, the approval rating decline will stop, and after three months, 10 percentage points will be recovered." (김민석 후보도 같은 날 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 지지율 하락에 대해 “중간층의 이완이 있었고, 전당대회를 둘러싸고 당 내부에서 벌어진 치열한 공방에 ‘내부에서 왜 싸우지’ 하고 (지지층이) 물러났다”고 진단했다. 김 후보는 “(6·3 지방선거를 계기로) 보수층의 기세가 올라왔고, 레버리지 ETF와 부동산 문제도 같이 발생했다”며 “제가 당선되면 (당정 불협화음이 사라져) 지지율 하락이 멈추고, 3개월 후에 10%p가 회복된다”고 주장했다.)

Within the Democratic Party, diagnoses and outlooks also diverge. A lawmaker from the party leadership said, "The approval rating decline is due to a combination of tax reform related to real estate and stocks, single-stock ETFs, and the free-for-all of the national convention," adding, "Since the candidates are aware of the severity of the situation, whoever becomes leader will likely issue a message of unity and move to stabilize things." In contrast, another Democratic Party source said, "Given the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers and the 'bus house' controversy, conditions exist for the president's and the party's approval ratings to fall together—it's just that the national convention has rallied supporters behind each candidate, making the party's approval rating look fine," adding, "Once a new party leader is chosen and time passes, the party's approval rating could also drop." (민주당 내에서도 진단과 전망이 엇갈린다. 당 지도부 한 의원은 “지지율 하락은 부동산·주식 관련 세제 개편과 단일 종목 ETF, 전당대회 난타전이 복합적으로 작용했기 때문”이라며 “후보들이 상황의 심각성을 인지하고 있는 만큼, 누가 대표가 되든 통합 메시지를 내면서 수습에 나서지 않겠느냐”고 했다. 반면 다른 민주당 관계자는 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지, ‘버스 하우스’ 논란 등으로 대통령과 당 지지율이 동반 하락할 만한 상황인데 전당대회로 각 후보 지지자들이 뭉치면서 당 지지율만 괜찮아 보이는 것일 뿐”이라며 “새 당대표가 뽑히고 시간이 지나면 당 지지율까지 빠질 가능성이 있다”고 했다.)

The party leader candidates also engaged in a slugfest in the final TV debate held that afternoon. Candidate Chung said, "Many ordinary investors are bruised and battered by single-stock ETFs," and "The law amendment and presiding over the cabinet meeting (regarding the launch of single-stock leveraged ETFs) were done by lawmaker Kim Min-seok (then prime minister)." Candidate Kim said, "Our narrow loss in the 2022 presidential election was because of Candidate Chung's 'Bong-i Kim Seon-dal' remark, which caused conflict between the party and the Buddhist community," and "Why did you refuse to apologize and refuse to leave the party at the time?" Candidate Song said, "Candidate Chung, during his time as party leader, without an accurate understanding of the administration's policy direction, went self-centeredly saying he would 'end the insurrection' and ended up reviving all the insurrectionist forces." (당대표 후보들은 이날 오후 열린 마지막 TV 토론에서도 난타전을 벌였다. 정 후보는 “단일 종목 ETF로 피멍 든 일반 투자자가 많다”며 “(단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 출시 관련) 법령안을 제출하고 국무회의를 주재한 것은 (당시 총리였던) 김민석 의원”이라고 했다. 김 후보는 “2022년 대선에서 우리가 근소하게 진 것은 정 후보의 ‘봉이 김선달’ 발언으로 (민주당과) 불교계가 갈등을 빚었기 때문”이라며 “당시 사과도 거부하고 탈당도 거부한 이유가 뭐냐”고 했다. 송 후보는 “정 후보가 (당대표 시절) 국정 기조에 대한 정확한 이해도 없이 자기 중심으로 ‘내란 종식’을 하겠다면서 내란 세력을 다 부활시켜 놨다”고 했다.)

item.title: Minister Kim Jeong-gwan: "Honam semiconductor plant's 2029 completion is already too slow" (김정관 장관 “호남 반도체 공장, 2029년 완공도 느린 것”)
item.description:
Minister Kim Jeong-gwan: "Honam semiconductor plant's 2029 completion is already too slow" (김정관 장관 “호남 반도체 공장, 2029년 완공도 느린 것”)

Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jeong-gwan said on the 12th regarding the location of the Honam semiconductor cluster that "the government proposed the site to the companies first." At a plenary session of the National Assembly's Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs and Startups Committee held that day, Minister Kim stated, "There was no pressure from the government or the ministry in deciding on Gwangju," adding this explanation. (김정관 산업통상부 장관이 호남 반도체 클러스터 입지와 관련해 “정부가 기업에 부지를 먼저 제안했다”고 12일 밝혔다. 김 장관은 이날 국회에서 열린 산업통상자원중소벤처기업위원회(이하 산자위) 전체회의에서 “광주로 결정하는 데 있어 정부나 산업부의 어떤 압박이 있지는 않았다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

On this day, the opposition party pressed for answers on the process of selecting the site for the Honam semiconductor cluster. People Power Party lawmaker Kim Do-eup asked, "Is it true that Samsung Electronics or SK hynix made the decision on the Honam semiconductor investment hub?" and further questioned, "Wasn't it made by the minister or President Lee?" Minister Kim responded, "The government proposed various sites, and the final selection was made by the companies." However, when lawmakers Woo Jae-joon and Seo Ji-young asked which candidate sites other than Gwangju were considered, Minister Kim did not provide specific answers. (이날 야당은 호남 반도체 클러스터 부지 선정 과정을 추궁했다. 국민의힘 김도읍 의원은 “호남 반도체 투자 거점 결정을 삼성전자나 SK하이닉스가 한 것이 맞나”라며 “장관 또는 이 대통령이 한 게 아니냐”고 물었다. 김 장관은 “다양한 부지를 정부가 제안했고 최종 선정은 기업이 했다”고 했다. 하지만 광주 이외의 후보지가 어디였는지 묻는 우재준·서지영 의원 등의 질의에 김 장관은 구체적으로 답하지 않았다.)

Regarding the 'blitzkrieg' goal of completing the first phase of a semiconductor fab (factory) on the site of the Gwangju military airfield by 2029, Minister Kim said, "From the perspective of the industry minister in charge of industry, manufacturing, and semiconductors, I believe even 2029 or 2030 is too slow." Responding to a question from People Power Party lawmaker Park Seong-min on whether the goal is actually achievable, Minister Kim said, "If we don't do it that way, we risk losing semiconductor competitiveness," adding this remark. (김 장관은 광주 군 공항 부지에 2029년까지 반도체 팹(fab·공장) 1차 완공을 한다는 ‘전격전’ 목표와 관련해, “산업·제조·반도체를 담당하는 산업부 장관 입장에서 봤을 때 2029년, 2030년도 느리다는 생각을 하고 있다”고도 했다. 김 장관은 과연 목표 달성이 가능한지 묻는 국민의힘 박성민 의원 질의에 “그렇게 하지 않으면 반도체 경쟁력을 잃을 것 같다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

Minister Kim also stated that discussions are underway to grant exceptions to the 52-hour workweek system within the Honam semiconductor cluster. In response to a question from Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Won-i about easing working hour regulations within the mega-special zone, Minister Kim said, "We are discussing various forms, including a white-collar exemption (a system to ease working hour regulations for high-income professionals) and the current flexible working hour system," adding, "We are closely consulting not only with industry and labor but also with the Ministry of Employment and Labor." (김 장관은 호남 반도체 클러스터에 주 52시간제 적용 예외 등을 주는 방안도 논의 중이라고 밝혔다. 김 장관은 메가특구 내 근로시간 규제 완화 논의에 대한 더불어민주당 김원이 의원의 질의를 받고 “화이트칼라 이그젬션(고소득 전문직 근로시간 규제 완화 제도)이나 현재 유연근무시간제도 등 다양한 형태에 대해서 논의 중”이라며 “산업계와 노동계는 물론 고용노동부와 머리를 맞대고 긴밀히 논의하고 있다”고 했다.)

However, Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Young-hoon, who attended the National Assembly's Environment and Labor Committee that day, said regarding the exception to the 52-hour workweek system that "it should be approached with caution." Minister Kim Young-hoon stated, "We will consider solutions that protect workers and also increase corporate productivity," while drawing the line on the exception to the 52-hour workweek system, saying, "Nothing has been decided by the government yet." (그러나 이날 국회 기후에너지환경노동위원회에 출석한 김영훈 고용노동부 장관은 주 52시간제 예외 적용과 관련해 “신중하게 접근해야 한다”고 말했다. 김영훈 장관은 “노동자를 보호하고 기업의 생산성도 올릴 수 있는 해법을 고민하겠다”면서도 주 52시간제 예외 적용과 관련해 “아직 정부에서 정해진 바는 없다”고 선을 그었다.)

item.title: Striking pro-Han allies while defending Jang... What's changed for Ahn Cheol-soo, and why? (친한 때리며 張 옹호… 달라진 안철수, 왜?)
item.description:
Striking pro-Han allies while defending Jang... What's changed for Ahn Cheol-soo, and why? (친한 때리며 張 옹호… 달라진 안철수, 왜?)

People Power Party (PPP) lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo (Seongnam Bundang-gap, Gyeonggi) on the 12th targeted the pro-Han faction pushing for the reinstatement of independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, arguing they should be "excluded from candidate nominations in the next general election." Ahn had previously voted in favor of impeaching former President Yoon Suk Yeol alongside the pro-Han faction and has been assessed as leaning toward a centrist line within the party. In opposition circles, some pointed to the pro-Han faction's attacks on Ahn during the insurrection special counsel trial as the cause, while others interpreted his move as potentially eyeing a bid in the next party leadership race or the Seoul mayoral by-election. <<> At a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Ahn said, "Those who serve a specific person outside the party (Han) and divide the party for that purpose should disappear from the People Power Party." He also called the pro-Han faction a "reinstatement movement group" and "lecca" (YouTubers who swarm trending events), adding, "They should be excluded from eligibility for support in the next general election." The remarks were interpreted as targeting certain pro-Han lawmakers facing disciplinary action from the party's ethics committee, as well as non-elected figures active as broadcast panelists. <<> In August last year, Ahn ran for party leader in the party convention, advocating a break with former President Yoon. However, when he recently appeared as a witness in the Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho's insurrection special counsel trial and testified that on the day of martial law, then-PPP leader Han Dong-hoon had also instructed people to gather at the PPP headquarters before going to the National Assembly, he faced fierce criticism from the pro-Han faction. In response, Ahn held a press conference, opposed Han's reinstatement, and suggested Han launch a new party instead. <<> Among non-mainstream factions, some assessed Ahn's press conference that day as "a show of support for PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who opposes Han's reinstatement." Ahn did not attend a press conference pushed by PPP lawmakers from Gyeonggi Province after the local elections demanding Jang's resignation, and on Constitution Day, he visited a rally at Seoul Olympic Park attended by a large number of hardline supporters. <<> A pro-Han lawmaker said, "Maybe Ahn has concluded that Jang's leadership will be prolonged and has started 'aligning with the Jang Dong-hyuk code.'" A senior PPP lawmaker said, "Ahn initially said he would run for the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee chairmanship, but after Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon received a sentence in the first trial that would strip him of his mayoral position, he withdrew his intention to run," adding, "It appears to be a decision considering the Seoul mayoral by-election or the next party leadership." Ahn's side responded, "Mayor Oh's Supreme Court ruling hasn't even come out yet, so talking about a by-election is itself absurd and a breach of party discipline." (국민의힘 안철수(경기 성남분당갑) 의원이 12일 무소속 한동훈 의원의 복당을 추진하는 친한계를 겨냥해 “차기 총선 공천에서 배제해야 한다”고 주장했다. 안 의원은 친한계와 함께 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵에 찬성했고, 당내에서도 중도 노선에 가깝다는 평가를 받아왔다. 야권에선 내란특검 재판 과정에서 친한계가 안 의원을 공격한 것을 원인으로 꼽으면서 안 의원이 차기 전당대회나 서울시장 보궐선거 출마 가능성을 염두에 둔 것 아니냐는 해석도 나왔다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "We Will Fight Again Through Lawsuits" After Election Commission Rejects Appeal (장동혁, 선관위 소청 기각에 “소송으로 다시 싸울 것”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "We Will Fight Again Through Lawsuits" After Election Commission Rejects Appeal (장동혁, 선관위 소청 기각에 “소송으로 다시 싸울 것”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on the 13th that, in response to the National Election Commission's rejection of the party's appeal regarding the June 3 Seoul mayoral election, "No one in the public will be able to accept this. We will fight again through election litigation." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 13일 중앙선거관리위원회가 자당이 제기한 6·3 서울시장 선거소청 등을 기각한 데 대해 “국민 누구도 납득할 수 없을 것이다. 선거 소송을 통해 다시 싸우겠다”고 했다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held that morning in Yeouido, Seoul, Jang said, "As expected, the National Election Commission rejected our party's election appeal." The previous day, the NEC ruled on the People Power Party's appeal regarding the Seoul mayoral election and others, citing ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections, stating, "While there were violations of election regulations regarding ballot shortages and voting interruptions in some polling stations, these facts cannot be seen as having affected the election results," and thus rejected the appeal. (장 대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “예상했던대로 중앙선관위가 우리 당의 선거소청을 기각했다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 전날 중앙선관위는 6·3 지방선거 당시 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 이유로 국민의힘이 제기한 서울시장 선거 등의 소청에 대해 “일부 투표구의 투표용지 부족 및 투표 중단에 관해서는 선거에 관한 규정을 위반한 사실이 존재하나, 이러한 사실이 선거 결과에 영향을 미친 것으로 볼 수 없다”며 기각 결정을 내렸다.)

Jang criticized the NEC, saying, "Even though ballot shortages and even computer manipulation were revealed, they're saying, 'Since you couldn't prove it affected the election results, we'll just reject it.' This shamelessness and irresponsibility have ultimately led them to grant themselves a pardon." He added, "We will uncover every truth through election litigation and a special counsel investigation." (장 대표는 중앙선관위를 향해 “투표용지 부족에 전산 조작까지 드러났는데도 당신들이 선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤다는 것을 입증 못했으니 우린 그냥 기각하고 말겠다는 것”이라며 “뻔뻔함과 무책임과 이런 것들이 결국 셀프 면죄부를 내놓게 만들었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “선거 소송과 특검을 통해 모든 진실을 낱낱이 밝히겠다”고 했다.)

Jang also said that evidence has emerged of foreign forces intervening in the elections through public opinion manipulation, and announced plans to push for a system requiring the display of nationality for online comments. "Aside from the NEC, forces threatening democracy have also been exposed," he said. "An international joint research team from KAIST and Germany's Max Planck Institute conducted a full analysis of 112 million Naver comments over ten years and found approximately 24,000 malicious accounts linked to foreign forces." (장 대표는 또 외국 세력이 여론 조작으로 우리 선거에 개입하고 있는 정황이 드러났다며 온라인 댓글 국적 표시제 도입을 추진하겠다고 밝혔다. 그는 “선관위 못지않게 민주주의를 위협하는 세력도 드러났다”며 ”KAIST(한국과학기술원)와 독일 막스플랑크연구소 국제 공동 연구팀이 10년 치 네이버 댓글 1억1200만여 건을 전수 분석한 결과 외국 세력과 연계된 악성 계정이 약 2만4000개나 나왔다“고 했다.)

Jang stated, "This is clear evidence that foreign forces are intervening in our elections through public opinion manipulation. The People Power Party will vigorously push for the introduction of a nationality disclosure system for online comments." (장 대표는 “외국 세력이 여론 조작으로 우리 선거에 개입하고 있다는 명백한 증거”라며 “국민의힘은 온라인 댓글 국적 표시제 도입을 강력하게 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The previous day, KAIST announced that research teams led by Professor Lee Won-jae of the Graduate School of Culture Technology and Professors Cha Meeyoung and Oh Hye-yeon of the School of Computing, in collaboration with the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy in Germany, analyzed 20 years of Naver news comment data and identified approximately 24,000 accounts suspected of foreign-linked influence operations. However, the researchers noted that these accounts tended not to support a specific political camp unilaterally, but rather amplified internal conflicts and divisions within Korean society. (전날 KAIST는 이원재 문화기술대학원 교수와 전산학부 차미영·오혜연 교수 연구팀이 독일 막스플랑크 보안·정보보호연구소와 함께 20년간의 네이버 뉴스 댓글 데이터를 분석한 결과 외국 연계 영향력 활동이 의심되는 계정 2만4000여 개를 확인했다고 밝혔다. 다만 연구진은 이 계정들이 특정 정치 진영을 일방적으로 지지하기보다는 한국 사회 내부의 갈등과 대립을 증폭시킨다고 분석했다.)

item.title: Government to Set Up 'Housing Supply Dashboard'... Prime Minister to Continuously Monitor Supply Situation (정부 ‘주택 공급 상황판’ 설치… 공급 상황 총리가 계속 챙긴다)
item.description:
Government to Set Up 'Housing Supply Dashboard'... Prime Minister to Continuously Monitor Supply Situation (정부 ‘주택 공급 상황판’ 설치… 공급 상황 총리가 계속 챙긴다)

From now on, the Prime Minister will directly oversee the housing supply situation. A 'housing supply dashboard' will also be established within the government. (앞으로는 국무총리가 주택 공급 상황을 직접 챙긴다. 정부 내에 ‘주택 공급 상황판’도 만들어진다.)

The government made this announcement on the 13th alongside the release of measures for the rapid supply of housing and comprehensive financial measures to stabilize the real estate market. (정부는 13일 주택 신속 공급 방안과 부동산 시장 안정을 위한 금융 종합 대책을 발표하면서 이 같은 계획을 함께 발표했다.)

At a joint briefing by relevant ministries held that morning at the Government Seoul Complex, Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yun-deok said, "To ensure that the government's policy efforts do not end as a one-off, we will establish a pan-governmental special housing supply governance system that can continuously review and supplement the supply situation." (이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 진행된 관계 부처 합동 발표에서 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관은 “정부의 정책적 노력이 일회성에 그치지 않도록, 지속적으로 공급 상황을 점검하고 보완할 수 있는 범정부 특별 주택 공급 거버넌스를 구축하겠다”고 했다.)

Minister Kim added, "We will strengthen the monitoring and coordination functions for the implementation of housing supply by newly establishing a 'Pan-Governmental Housing Rapid Supply Review Meeting' chaired by the Prime Minister, and we will closely manage the supply sites by installing a 'Rapid Supply Innovation Task Force' led by the First Vice Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport to actively resolve on-site difficulties together with local governments." (김 장관은 “국무총리 주재 ‘범정부 주택 신속 공급 점검 회의’를 신설해 주택 공급 이행 상황에 대한 점검·조정 기능을 강화하고, 국토부 1차관을 단장으로 ‘신속 공급 혁신단’을 설치해 지방정부와 함께 현장 애로 요인을 적극 해소하는 등 공급 현장을 밀착 관리하겠다”고 했다.)

According to the Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Prime Minister will henceforth use the pan-governmental housing rapid supply review meeting to check whether public and private housing supply projects across the country are proceeding without setbacks. When there are projects that fall behind schedule, the meeting will discuss what actions each ministry should take, and the Prime Minister will directly mediate any disagreements between ministries. The first meeting is scheduled for the 14th. (국무조정실에 따르면, 앞으로 총리는 범정부 주택 신속 공급 점검 회의를 통해 전국에서 진행되는 공공·민간의 주택 공급 사업이 차질 없이 진행되는지를 점검하게 된다. 일정이 지연되는 사업이 있을 때는 각 부처가 해야 하는 조치가 무엇인지를 회의에서 함께 논의하고, 부처 간 이견은 총리가 직접 조정하게 된다. 오는 14일 첫 회의를 열 예정이다.)

To support the meeting chaired by the Prime Minister, a 'Housing Rapid Supply Working Meeting' chaired by the Second Deputy Prime Minister for the Office for Government Policy Coordination will also be established. (총래 주재 회의를 뒷받침하기 위해 국무조정실 2차장이 주재하는 ‘주택 신속 공급 실무 회의’도 생긴다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination also launched a 'Housing Rapid Supply Monitoring Team' on the 11th. Comprising five public officials dispatched from the Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Korea Land and Housing Corporation (LH), the team will continuously track the progress of each housing supply project across the country and create a 'housing supply dashboard' summarizing the findings for sharing within the government. (국조실 내에는 지난 11일 ‘주택 신속 공급 점검팀’도 생겼다. 국조실과 국토부, 한국토지주택공사(LH)에서 파견된 공직자 5명으로 구성된 팀은 전국에서 진행되는 주택 공급 사업 각각의 진척 현황을 지속적으로 파악하고, 이를 정리한 내용을 담은 ‘주택 공급 상황판’을 만들어 정부 내에 공유하게 된다.)

Office for Government Policy Coordination Chief Lim Ki-geun said, "The success or failure of these (real estate) measures depends on how quickly we supply housing and thereby restore market confidence," adding, "We will constantly monitor the implementation status through the pan-governmental housing supply review system." (임기근 국무조정실장은 “이번 (부동산) 대책의 성패는 얼마나 신속하게 주택을 공급하고 이를 통해 시장의 신뢰를 회복하느냐에 달려 있다”며 “범정부 주택 공급 점검 체계를 통해 이행 상황을 상시 점검하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Even "Goldfish IQ" Comes Up... Late-Stage Race Turns Sharper with 'Short-Hit Negative' Campaigning (“붕어 IQ”까지 나왔다… 與전대 막판 독해지는 ‘단타 네거티브’)
item.description:
Even "Goldfish IQ" Comes Up... Late-Stage Race Turns Sharper with 'Short-Hit Negative' Campaigning (“붕어 IQ”까지 나왔다… 與전대 막판 독해지는 ‘단타 네거티브’)

"The video is preserved as evidence, so why tell such obvious lies? This isn't goldfish IQ." (“영상이 박제가 돼 있는데 뻔한 거짓말을 왜 하느냐. 붕어 IQ도 아니고.”)

On the 13th, four days before the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, party leader candidate Song Young-gil directed these words at his rival candidate Jung Chung-rae. Song claimed on CBS Radio that day that Jung had said right after the June 3 local elections that the party, government, and presidential office had coordinated to assess the election results as a victory, but recently changed his explanation to "coordination between the party and the presidential office." He then attacked Jung, saying "If you're going to lie, you need to be smart," implying Jung doesn't remember his own past statements. <<> Critics point out that after the final TV debate the previous day, the competition among the Democratic Party leadership contenders has devolved into short, provocative "short-hit negative" attacks targeting opponents' verbal slips, past records, and relationships with President Lee Jae-myung, rather than policy and vision. The skirmishes that began in the TV debates have migrated to social media and radio after the debates ended. Jung posted a video of his verbal clash with Song from the previous night on Facebook, writing "Such a big man, but..." He also engaged in a war of nerves with candidate Kim Min-seok, taking issue with his individual word choices. <<> Song escalated his attacks on Jung to new heights that day. After criticizing Jung's response as "slipping away like a loach," he said "He doesn't even have the ability to lie." Last month, he attacked Jung for repeatedly emphasizing his relationship with President Lee, calling it "stalker-level behavior toward President Lee Jae-myung." That day, he also said Jung failed to properly answer what the president's first national task was, calling it "a serious problem and a shameful thing." <<> Jung did not back down either. During the SBS TV debate on the previous day, the 12th, when Song mentioned a conversation he had with President Lee, Jung rebutted that it was inappropriate to publicly disclose details of conversations with the president. When Song tried to explain himself, Jung said, "A man of your size shouldn't make such careless remarks." After the debate, he shared a video of the scene on his Facebook page titled "Older brother Young-gil getting scolded for showing off." <<> A war of nerves even broke out between Jung and Kim over a single word. When Kim said he "commends" (chiha) Jung's one year of party leader activities, Jung responded, "'Commend' is an expression used by superiors toward subordinates" and called it "a disrespectful attitude." Kim shot back, saying "You must have read a Japanese dictionary," noting that in Korean it can also be used between equals. Jung later posted a dictionary search screenshot on Facebook, targeting Kim again. <<> The candidates also continued exchanging "quiz-style questions" under the guise of verifying each other's policy competence. After Song asked Jung about the first national task of the Lee Jae-myung administration in an earlier debate, Jung returned the favor in the final debate by asking Song about national task No. 50. Jung also asked Kim about how much housing supply, among President Lee's housing pledges, should be handled by LH (Land and Housing Corporation), to which Kim objected, saying "A debate among three people should not sink to the level of a quiz show." <<> In the final stretch of the convention, not just current issues but political choices from over 20 years ago and responsibility for past presidential election defeats are being dragged up as attack material. <<> Kim brought up in the final TV debate the previous day an incident where Jung, during the 2022 parliamentary audit, compared temples' cultural property admission fees to "toll fees" and likened temples to "Bongyi Kim Seon-dal" (a classic Korean swindler), sparking conflict with the Buddhist community. Kim argued this hurt the party in the 2022 presidential election and pressed Jung on why he hadn't apologized more actively at the time. <<> Jung immediately brought up Kim's departure from the Democratic Party in 2002 to support candidate Chung Mong-joon. Jung told Kim, "You seem to have betrayal trauma," and Kim shot back by citing Jung's past conflict with the Buddhist community, saying "You ruined the presidential election." Thus, within a policy debate, a party departure from 24 years ago and responsibility for a presidential election from four years ago came to the fore. <<> Throughout this convention, Jung's signature attack word targeting Kim has been "betrayal." Citing Kim's 2002 party departure, Jung said, "Once a betrayer, always a betrayer," and Kim's camp protested this as excessive labeling. Earlier this month, Jung even said of Kim, "He ran away from home for 18 years and now demands the house deed." <<> The clash over the "suspected Shincheonji intervention in the primary" has even spilled into questions of disciplinary action after the convention. When Kim raised the possibility of a specific religious group intervening in the Democratic Party's primary, Jung defined this as "an act subject to sanctions" and said that if he becomes party leader, he will order an ethics investigation. Kim retorted, "Is warning about religious group intervention in the primary an act subject to sanctions? Are you trying to run the party with intimidation?" Jung has maintained through recently that this issue needs to be resolved after the convention. <<> In the dispute over election rules, words like "coup" and "riot" have even surfaced. When some supreme council member candidates demanded giving additional voting opportunities to rights-bearing party members who couldn't vote, Jung called this a "voting coup" and said changing the rules would cause "riots." Even in the supreme council member race, terms like "Ilbe" and "bat" have appeared, showing the emotional battles in the party leader race spreading to the entire leadership contest. <<> In their closing statements at the final TV debate the previous day, all three candidates uniformly emphasized "unity." Jung appealed to "loyalty" to the party, Song said the three candidates share "the same roots" and urged them to work together after the convention, and Kim also pledged to unify the party after the convention. <<> However, critics note that the actual atmosphere within the party is far from that. Even while emphasizing unity, Jung has not withdrawn his plan for an ethics investigation into Kim's Shincheonji-related claims. When asked whether a party split after the convention was even a possibility, Jung said on the 10th, "Don't say such things," adding "I haven't even thought about it." <<> The Democratic Party leadership has also halted open supreme council meetings this week, just before the convention. The supreme council, which typically met on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, will now meet behind closed doors until the convention. The party says there are no particular matters requiring public resolution, but inside and outside the party, interpretations suggest the leadership is trying to prevent further exposure of conflict, as pro-Lee and pro-Jung supreme council members have repeatedly attacked each other's camps in public settings. <<> Voices within the party are also worrying about the aftermath of the primary. Lawmaker Yoon Kun-young recently described this convention as "hot to the point of being on the verge of explosion," saying the party should not end up "uprooting the very pillars of the household" just to win an immediate election. Lawmaker Kim Young-jin also cited the Democratic Party's past history of splits, saying this convention should not go down that path. <<> The Democratic Party's convention preparation committee announced in early last month, before the convention began, that it would take strong action against excessive negativity such as the use of derogatory terms. However, as voting day approaches, the exchanges between candidates have instead grown rougher, moving toward imprinting "lies," "betrayal," and "incompetence" in short phrases rather than addressing each other's policies. A political source said, "The emotional battle has escalated to the point where it's hard to see them as fellow party members fighting each other. If the losing camp cannot be embraced after the 17th decides the winner, the post-convention fallout could last for a considerable time. The new leader's first task will not be winning elections but stitching the party back together." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 나흘 앞둔 13일 송영길 당대표 후보가 경쟁자인 정청래 후보를 향해 이렇게 말했다. 송 후보는 이날 CBS 라디오에서 정 후보가 6·3 지방선거 직후 당·정·청이 선거 결과를 승리로 평가하기로 조율했다는 취지로 말했다가 최근에는 ‘당·청 간 조율’이라고 설명을 바꿨다고 주장했다. 그러면서 “거짓말을 하려면 머리가 좋아야 한다”며 정 후보가 과거 자기 발언을 기억하지 못한다는 취지로 공격했다.)

item.title: President Lee's approval rating at 49%... lowest since taking office [NBS] (李대통령 지지율 49%... 취임 이후 최저치 [NBS])
item.description:
President Lee's approval rating at 49%... lowest since taking office [NBS] (李대통령 지지율 49%... 취임 이후 최저치 [NBS])

A survey result showed that positive evaluations of President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs management fell below 50% for the first time since his inauguration, recording the lowest figure. (이재명 대통령에 대한 국정운영 긍정 평가가 취임 후 처음으로 50% 아래로 떨어지며 최저치를 기록했다는 조사 결과가 나왔다.)

In the National Barometer Survey (NBS) conducted by Embrain Public, Kstat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research on 1,001 people nationwide from the 10th to the 12th and released on the 13th, positive evaluations of the President's state affairs management stood at 49%, while negative evaluations were 43%. (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 지난 10~12일 전국 1001명을 대상으로 시행해 13일 발표한 전국지표조사(NBS)에서 이 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정적 평가는 49%, 부정적 평가는 43%로 나타났다.)

The positive evaluation marked the lowest figure since the President took office in the same survey. Among moderate voters, positive and negative evaluations were similar at 47% and 46%, respectively. (긍정 평가는 같은 조사에서 이 대통령 취임 이후 가장 낮은 수치를 기록했다. 중도층에서 긍정 평가와 부정 평가가 각각 47%, 46%로 비슷한 수준이었다.)

Party support ratings were as follows: Democratic Party of Korea 40%, People Power Party 23%, Fatherland Innovation Party 2%, Reform Party 2%, and Progressive Party 1%. (정당 지지도는 더불어민주당 40%, 국민의힘 23%, 조국혁신당 2%, 개혁신당 2%, 진보당 1% 등으로 나타났다.)

Regarding the current government's real estate policy, 34% gave a positive evaluation saying it is "doing well," while 56% gave a negative evaluation saying it is "doing poorly." On the real estate tax reform proposal, 46% were in favor and 41% were against. (현 정부의 부동산 정책에 대해선 ‘잘하고 있다’는 긍정 평가가 34%, ‘잘못하고 있다’는 부정 평가는 56%로 나타났다. 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해선 찬성 46%, 반대 41%로 조사됐다.)

For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Lee: "Supply cliff from 2022... Secure housing sites even by revising the law" (李 “2022년부터 공급 절벽... 법 개정해서라도 택지 확보”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung ordered relevant ministries to launch an "all-out supply war," including aggressively securing housing sites even by revising laws and institutions, and drastically shortening permitting procedures, to resolve the "supply cliff." He also instructed that after policy announcements, opinions from the public and the opposition party be gathered to revise and supplement the measures. (이재명 대통령이 ‘공급 절벽’을 해소하기 위해 법과 제도를 개정해서라도 파격적으로 택지를 확보하고 인허가 절차를 대폭 단축하는 등 ‘전방위적 공급 총력전’에 나설 것을 관계 부처에 지시했다. 아울러 정책 발표 후 국민과 야당의 의견을 수렴해 대책을 수정·보완하라고 했다.)

◇"Aggressive housing site acquisition even at the cost of legal revisions" (◇“법 개정 불사한 파격적 택지 확보”)

In his opening remarks at the meeting, the President identified "supply shortage" as the most urgent issue threatening the current real estate market. "Not only are housing prices in our society extremely high by global standards, but if this situation persists, a so-called 'lost 20 or 30 years' phenomenon could arrive," the President said. "To resolve the time-bomb-like housing problem, we must concentrate all available means and capabilities across supply, tax, and financial policies." (이 대통령은 회의 모두 발언에서 현재 부동산 시장을 위협하는 가장 시급한 문제로 ‘공급 부족’을 꼽았다. 이 대통령은 “우리 사회의 부동산 가격이 전 세계적으로 매우 높을 뿐만 아니라, 이 상황이 지속되면 소위 ‘잃어버린 20년, 30년’ 같은 현상이 도래할 수 있다”며 “시한폭탄 같은 부동산 문제 해결을 위해 공급·세제·금융 정책 전반에 가용한 수단과 역량을 집중 투입해야 한다”고 했다.)

He particularly pointed out structural disruptions in the supply sector. "We have been in a supply cliff state from 2022 until now. Permits have been greatly reduced and construction starts have also declined significantly, inevitably creating a supply cliff, so extraordinary efforts are needed to fill that gap," the President said. However, the opposition party cites the cancellation of large-scale redevelopment and reconstruction projects during former Seoul Mayor Park Won-soon's tenure as a cause of the supply shortage. (특히 공급 부문의 구조적 차질을 지적했다. 이 대통령은 “2022년부터 지금까지 공급 절벽 상태다. 인허가도 매우 축소됐고 착공도 많이 줄어들어서 불가피하게 공급 절벽이 발생했기 때문에, 이를 메우기 위한 특단의 노력이 필요하다”고 했다. 다만 야당은 박원순 전 서울시장 시절 대규모 재개발·재건축 취소 등을 공급 부족 원인으로 꼽는다.)

"Since supply policies involve long lead times and many practical constraints, we must wage an all-out supply war with special resolve," the President said. "We must shorten various permitting procedures as much as possible, and for housing sites, we should not be bound by existing regulations—if necessary, secure them aggressively even by amending laws and institutions to move forward with supply." (이 대통령은 “공급 정책은 소요 기간이 길고 현실적 제한이 많은 만큼 특별한 각오를 갖고 전방위적인 공급 총력전에 나서야 한다”며 “각종 인허가 절차를 최대한 단축하고, 택지도 기존 규제에 얽매이지 말고 필요하면 법과 제도를 고쳐서라도 파격적으로 확보해서 공급에 나서야 한다”고 했다.)

◇"Calling policy refinements 'flip-flopping' is an outdated approach" (◇“정책 보완을 ‘오락가락’이라 부르는 건 낡은 방식”)

The President instructed that after announcing housing supply measures, opinions from the public, experts, and the political sphere be gathered to revise and supplement the policies. "Public officials cannot be 100 percent perfect," the President said. "Drafting the best possible proposal, then incorporating reasonable suggestions from the public and the opposition to make it a more complete set of measures, is the normal policy-making process." (이 대통령은 부동산 공급 대책 발표 이후 국민, 전문가, 정치권의 의견을 수렴해 정책을 수정·보완하라고 지시했다. 이 대통령은 “공무원이 100% 완벽할 수 없다”며 “최선을 다해 안을 만들되 국민과 야당의 합리적인 제안을 수렴해 더 완벽한 대책으로 만들어가는 것이 정상적인 정책 결정 과정”이라고 했다.)

He continued: "Expressing that an initial proposal has changed or has been revised to incorporate reasonable ideas as 'lacking policy consistency,' 'flip-flopping,' or 'patching together a ragbag' is an outdated way of thinking from the past," he said. "Public servants should not be swayed by such criticism but boldly gather opinions from the public, experts, and the opposition, and pragmatically complete well-structured measures that fit the real lives of the people." (이어 “처음 나온 안이 바뀌거나 합리적 안을 수용해 수정했다고 해서 ‘정책 일관성이 없다’ ‘오락가락이다’ ‘누더기를 만들었다’고 표현하는 것은 낡은 과거 방식”이라며 “공직자들은 이런 비판에 구애받지 말고 과감하게 국민과 전문가, 야당의 의견을 수렴해 국민의 실제 삶에 맞도록 실용적인 대책을 짜임새 있게 완성해 나가야 한다”고 했다.)

◇Eliminating the "marriage penalty" and moving away from supplier-centered administration (◇‘결혼 페널티’ 해소 및 공급자 중심 행정 탈피)

The President addressed the so-called "marriage penalty," where marriage actually reduces opportunities for housing lotteries or loans, saying, "When single, men and women each had separate opportunities, but when combined, they decrease—that is unreasonable." He added, "Breaking away from administratively convenient, supplier-centered thinking and continuously improving policies so that people do not perceive unfairness from their perspective is what truly competent administration looks like," urging full efforts to build a "housing ladder" for people's residential stability and homeownership. (이 대통령은 혼인 시 오히려 청약이나 대출 기회가 줄어드는 이른바 ‘결혼 페널티’를 언급하며 “홀몸일 때는 남녀가 따로 기회를 가졌는데 합치니까 오히려 줄어드는 것은 불합리하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “행정 편의적인 공급자 중심 사고에서 벗어나 국민의 시각에서 불공정하다는 생각이 들지 않도록 정책을 끊임없이 개선하는 것이 진짜 유능한 행정”이라며 국민의 주거 안정과 내 집 마련을 위한 ‘주거 사다리’ 구축에 총력을 다할 것을 당부했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Introduce Selective Volunteer System to Become a Smart Strong Military... Pursue Defense Reform" (李대통령 “선택적 모병제 도입해 스마트 강군으로...국방개혁 추진”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 13th regarding military reform, "We must swiftly and thoroughly pursue defense reform to introduce a selective volunteer system and transform our military into a smart, elite, strong force centered on advanced equipment and technology." (이재명 대통령은 13일 군 개혁과 관련해 “선택적 모병제를 도입해 우리 군을 첨단 장비와 기술 중심의 스마트 정예 강군으로 탈바꿈시키려는 국방 개혁을 빠르고 빈틈없이 추진해야 한다”고 말했다.)

At a senior advisors' meeting held at the presidential office that day, President Lee stated, "Due to the continued low birth rate, maintaining the current inefficient military structure focused on manpower and infantry is neither feasible nor desirable." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 수석보좌관 회의에서 “지속적인 저출생 때문에 현재와 같은 인력 중심, 보병 중심의 비효율적 군 구조를 유지하는 것은 가능하지도, 바람직하지도 않다”며 이같이 말했다.)

The "selective volunteer system" mentioned by President Lee is a concept that maintains the conscription system while converting certain specialized fields to a volunteer-based system. (이 대통령이 언급한 ‘선택적 모병제’는, 징병제를 유지하되 일부 전문 분야를 모병제로 전환하는 개념이다.)

President Lee has referred to the selective volunteer system on several occasions. When visiting the Marine Corps Yeonpyeong unit last June, he said, "We will minimize conscripted soldiers and change the system so that people can choose the military as their own workplace through volunteer enlistment." At that time, President Lee personally explained the selective volunteer system, saying, "The intent is that, to the extent possible within the budget, it would be better to choose either becoming long-term professional soldiers who receive fair and sufficient pay, or, if that's not preferred, opting to serve short-term conscription." (이 대통령은 그동안 수차례 선택적 모병제를 언급해 왔다. 지난 6월 해병대 연평부대를 방문했을 때도 “징집병을 최소화하고 모병을 통해 자기 자신의 직장으로 군을 선택할 수 있게 바꿔나가겠다”고 했다. 당시 이 대통령은 선택적 모병제에 대해 직접 설명하면서 “예산이 허용하는 범위 내에서 최대한 가능하면, 정상적이고 충분한 보수를 지급받는 약간의 장기 직업 군인을 선택하든지, 그게 싫으면 단기 징병에 응하는 (것으로) 선택하는 게 낫다는 그런 취지”라고 했다.)

In March, at a meeting of key military commanders held at the Ministry of National Defense, he said, "I ask that you also accelerate defense reform, including the selective volunteer system." (지난 3월엔 국방부에서 열린 전군 주요 지휘관 회의에서 “선택적 모병제 등 국방 개혁에도 속도를 내주기 바란다”고 했다.)
